T: You'll believe a man can fly. And cook.
D: A baby from Krypton grows up to become Superman in Metropolis.
P: Serve the mains when Superman catches Lois on the helicopter.
S: Corn boiled 5 minutes, charred on a grill, rolled in butter, salt and a little smoked paprika.
Perry White's office at the paper
Cake doughnuts warmed for 2 minutes and dipped in a thin vanilla glaze (icing sugar, milk, vanilla), sprinkles on half of them.

Lime jelly made firm with extra gelatine, set in a slab, cut into jagged crystal shards, piled on a plate with whipped cream.

s.how: Boil 4 corn cobs for 5 minutes, then char on a hot grill for 5 minutes, turning. Cut each cob in half. Roll in 40g softened butter and sprinkle with sea salt flakes and 1 tsp smoked paprika.

s.note: lime green, keep it away from the guest of honour
s.how: Make 2 packets of lime jelly crystals with 400ml boiling water instead of the usual amount, adding 2 softened gelatine leaves to set it firm. Pour into a lined slab tin and chill 4 hours. Cut into jagged crystal shards, pile on a plate and serve with 200ml whipped thickened cream.

m.how: Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tsp salt. Dredge in 200g flour seasoned with paprika and pepper and fry at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes until 74C inside. Boil 800g potatoes, mash with butter and milk. Make gravy with 2 tbsp of the fat, 2 tbsp flour and 400ml chicken stock.

w.note: white and icy, like the crystals
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites and 220g caster sugar in a bowl over simmering water until the sugar dissolves, then whisk off the heat with 1/4 tsp cream of tartar until stiff and glossy. Pipe tall jagged crystal shapes on lined trays and bake at 100C for 90 minutes. Cool in the oven and dust with edible glitter.

d.how: Brew 1 litre of drip coffee with 60g ground coffee. Pour into four big mugs and put 200ml warm milk and a bowl of sugar on the desk so everyone fixes their own.
